d.ko: Local gangs got you laid off your shit job. In the urban jungle of possibilities, your survival instincts kick in to keep a roof over your head, find ways to make bread alone or with your buddies.
d.en: Local gangs got you laid off your shit job. In the urban jungle of possibilities, your survival instincts kick in to keep a roof over your head, find ways to make bread alone or with your buddies.
d.zh: 当地帮派害你丢了那份破工作。在这座充满无限可能的都市丛林里，你的生存本能瞬间觉醒——为了保住头顶这片遮风挡雨的屋檐，单枪匹马或拉上好兄弟一起想办法搞钱吧。
